All datasets are generated by `tools/make_data.py` with fixed random seeds, so everyone gets identical numbers. They live in the `data/` folder of the repository. Click a file name to download it.

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**Stylised teaching data, not official statistics.** The macro series follow the broad path of the Nigerian and global economy — reform dates, turning points, orders of magnitude — but every value is generated for teaching. For real numbers, run `tools/fetch_official_data.py` (or `.R`), or go to the CBN, NBS, IMF, World Bank and FRED websites.
:::
